Application Data.NAME: Smith & Sons Boiler Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Sons Boiler Services specializes in the installation and repair of residential and light commercial boiler and furnace systems. Our operations are conducted within low- to medium-risk environments, ensuring compliance with local building codes and safety regulations. We maintain a strong commitment to worker safety, implementing rigorous training programs in alignment with OSHA standards. Our team is fully equipped with personal protective equipment (PPE) and adheres to documented equipment maintenance protocols. We engage subcontractors strictly for specialized tasks, ensuring they possess adequate insurance and indemnification agreements. Our services also include the installation of associated safety systems, such as carbon monoxide detectors, in compliance with environmental regulations. We have a proven track record of minimal claims history, demonstrating our proactive approach to risk management and safety.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a minor fire occurred during a routine boiler installation due to an accidental spark from a tool, resulting in property damage to the surrounding area. The damage was assessed at $2,500.00 and was fully covered by our insurance. The claim has been resolved and closed as of 04/20/2022. On 08/10/2023, we experienced a small water leak from a furnace repair that caused minimal damage to a client's property, estimated at $2,500.00. The issue was promptly fixed, and the client agreed not to file a claim. No outstanding claims or pending issues remain.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1 Safe, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing around job sites, including perimeter lighting, and routine security patrols during off-hours to mitigate theft and ensure worker safety.
